REQ-1.description: The chart notes: the month on screen is not a link in The last six months, Day by day has the same hover, and every chart shows its value at once on hover, focus or tap

REQ-2.description: M4's follow-ups: the gallery's chart components and close button (O-12), one set of percentages for donut and legend (O-13), The last six months read once (O-14), the hardened literal-text guard

REQ-3.description: Payments stored: the settlement record and its reader, the database's version-2 migration keeping every version-1 record, the repository with its reference checks

REQ-4.description: A failed migration has its own state, with nothing changed and a reload (O-4)

REQ-5.description: Net balance per member, derived from the ledger: paid minus share plus sent minus received, exact to the cent, summing to zero

REQ-6.description: Suggested settlement: the fewest payments that clear every balance, with a deterministic tie-break, each with Mark as paid

REQ-7.description: Record a payment, full or partial, between any two members

REQ-8.description: Explain a balance: the expenses and payments that make it up, summing to it

REQ-9.description: Payments in the history, editable and deletable like an expense, without counting in spending totals

REQ-10.description: Settle-up summary as text, copied or shared

REQ-12.description: Members who left: their balance is kept and shown, they can pay or be paid, and a member named by a payment can't be deleted

REQ-13.description: Property tests (balances sum to zero, the suggestion clears them, partial payments and members who left covered) and hand-checked examples for Phase 3's edge cases

REQ-14.description: Both languages, the design canvas's look, 360 px without sideways scroll, keyboard and screen-reader access

REQ-15.description: Documentation and the design canvas: ADRs, DESIGN.md, READMEs, roadmap, the navigation map and the shipped board
